# Generated by the ZIN content builder (modules/mech_elves.mjs, mech_lerendor.mjs, mech_volgan.mjs; docs/design/stage2/mech_powers.md). Do not edit by hand.
# Scope: Lerendor. Swaps the band spirits at 40 and -40.
zin_leren_update_treaty_band = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_strait_standing value = 40 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = zin_leren_treaty_trusted } } add_ideas = zin_leren_treaty_trusted }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_leren_treaty_broken_faith } remove_ideas = zin_leren_treaty_broken_faith }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_strait_standing value = -40 compare = less_than_or_equals } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = zin_leren_treaty_broken_faith } } add_ideas = zin_leren_treaty_broken_faith }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_leren_treaty_trusted } remove_ideas = zin_leren_treaty_trusted }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_leren_treaty_trusted } remove_ideas = zin_leren_treaty_trusted }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_leren_treaty_broken_faith } remove_ideas = zin_leren_treaty_broken_faith }
	}
}

# Any scope. Argument: zin_arg_value. Adds to Lerendor's standing while the treaty stands (the only way other specs change it).
zin_leren_add_strait_standing = {
	if = {
		limit = { zin_leren_treaty_in_force = yes }
		LER = {
			add_to_variable = { zin_strait_standing = zin_arg_value }
			clamp_variable = { var = zin_strait_standing min = -100 max = 100 }
			zin_leren_update_treaty_band = yes
		}
	}
}

# Scope: Lerendor. Argument: zin_arg_level (0 to 4). Level 3 needs Full Strait Dues, level 4 the Iron Toll (section 2).
zin_leren_set_toll_level = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_level = zin_arg_level }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_t_level value = 4 compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_level = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_t_level value = 0 compare = less_than } } set_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_level = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_t_level value = 3 compare = greater_than } NOT = { zin_leren_tree_iron_toll = yes } } set_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_level = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_t_level value = 2 compare = greater_than } NOT = { zin_leren_tree_full_dues = yes } NOT = { zin_leren_tree_iron_toll = yes } } set_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_level = 2 } }
	set_variable = { zin_leren_toll_level = zin_leren_t_level }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_toll_level value = 0 compare = equals } }
		set_variable = { zin_leren_toll_pp = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_toll_level value = 1 compare = equals } }
		set_variable = { zin_leren_toll_pp = 0.05 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_toll_level value = 2 compare = equals } }
		set_variable = { zin_leren_toll_pp = 0.1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_toll_level value = 3 compare = equals } }
		set_variable = { zin_leren_toll_pp = 0.15 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_toll_level value = 4 compare = equals } }
		set_variable = { zin_leren_toll_pp = 0.25 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_toll_level value = 0 compare = equals } }
		set_variable = { zin_leren_toll_cg = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_toll_level value = 1 compare = equals } }
		set_variable = { zin_leren_toll_cg = -0.01 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_toll_level value = 2 compare = equals } }
		set_variable = { zin_leren_toll_cg = -0.02 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_toll_level value = 3 compare = equals } }
		set_variable = { zin_leren_toll_cg = -0.03 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_toll_level value = 4 compare = equals } }
		set_variable = { zin_leren_toll_cg = -0.04 }
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

# Scope: Lerendor. Argument: zin_arg_value. Cohesion drives the stability and authority of the union (section 3).
zin_leren_add_union_cohesion = {
	add_to_variable = { zin_leren_union_cohesion = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_leren_union_cohesion min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { zin_leren_union_stab = zin_leren_union_cohesion }
	add_to_variable = { zin_leren_union_stab = -50 }
	divide_variable = { zin_leren_union_stab = 500 }
	set_variable = { zin_leren_union_pp = zin_leren_union_cohesion }
	add_to_variable = { zin_leren_union_pp = -50 }
	divide_variable = { zin_leren_union_pp = 1000 }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = zin_leren_union_cohesion value = 80 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_leren_one_throne_seen }
		}
		set_country_flag = zin_leren_one_throne_seen
		country_event = { id = zin_leren.81 }
	}
}

# Scope: a North Lands, Dark Lands or Andos Enda country. Argument: zin_arg_value. Parim's courting uses negative values.
zin_leren_add_lean = {
	add_to_variable = { zin_leren_lean = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_leren_lean min = -100 max = 100 }
}

# Scope: Lerendor. Weight 1 for a North Lands state a Compact member holds, 1.5 for one Lerendor or its subjects hold, over the 54 states Lerendor did not start with (section 4).
zin_leren_update_hegemony = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_heg = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			zin_is_region_north_lands = yes
			NOT = { has_state_flag = zin_leren_home_state }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { zin_leren_state_held = yes }
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_heg = 1.5 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { controller = { is_in_faction_with = LER } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_heg = 1 }
		}
	}
	multiply_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_heg = 100 }
	divide_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_heg = 54 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = zin_leren_t_heg min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { zin_leren_hegemony = zin_leren_t_heg }
	set_variable = { zin_leren_heg_pp = zin_leren_hegemony }
	divide_variable = { zin_leren_heg_pp = 400 }
	set_variable = { zin_leren_heg_trade = zin_leren_hegemony }
	divide_variable = { zin_leren_heg_trade = 500 }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

# Scope: Lerendor. Removes the grievance spirits and the opinions of the toll quarrel.
zin_leren_clear_grievances = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_leren_grievance_1716 } remove_ideas = zin_leren_grievance_1716 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_leren_grievance_unanswered } remove_ideas = zin_leren_grievance_unanswered }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = AEN }
		remove_opinion_modifier = { target = AEN modifier = zin_opinion_toll_of_1716 }
		remove_opinion_modifier = { target = AEN modifier = zin_leren_envoys_mocked }
	}
}

# Any scope. The withdrawal of section 7: flag, date, opinions, access, faction, the torn treaty, Gathering Dark +4, the events. Standing is frozen because zin_leren_add_strait_standing does nothing once the flag is set.
zin_leren_withdraw = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_leren_treaty_in_force = yes
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_leren_withdrawal
		set_variable = { global.zin_leren_withdrawal_date = global.date }
		set_variable = { global.zin_leren_withdrawal_year = global.year }
		LER = {
			remove_opinion_modifier = { target = AEN modifier = zin_leren_treaty_partner }
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = AEN modifier = zin_leren_treaty_broken }
			diplomatic_relation = { country = AEN relation = military_access active = no }
			if = { limit = { is_in_faction_with = AEN } leave_faction = yes }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_leren_treaty_torn days = 365 }
			if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_leren_grievance_unanswered } remove_ideas = zin_leren_grievance_unanswered }
			country_event = { id = zin_leren.30 }
		}
		AEN = {
			remove_opinion_modifier = { target = LER modifier = zin_leren_treaty_partner }
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = LER modifier = zin_leren_treaty_broken }
			diplomatic_relation = { country = LER relation = military_access active = no }
			country_event = { id = zin_leren.31 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 4 }
		zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			news_event = { id = zin_leren.32 }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Lerendor joins every defensive war of Aenor under the treaty (section 6).
zin_leren_join_aenor_defence = {
	if = { limit = { zin_leren_treaty_in_force = yes } LER = {
			AEN = {
				every_enemy_country = {
					limit = {
						AEN = { has_defensive_war_with = PREV }
						NOT = { is_in_faction_with = LER }
						NOT = { is_subject_of = LER }
					}
					save_event_target_as = zin_leren_foe
					LER = {
						add_to_war = {
							targeted_alliance = AEN
							enemy = event_target:zin_leren_foe
							hostility_reason = asked_to_join
							single_target_only = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = zin_leren_treaty_honoured
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			news_event = { id = zin_leren.33 }
		}
	}
}

# Scope: Lerendor. Argument: zin_arg_target. The strait is shut to one country for 180 days.
zin_leren_close_strait = {
	var:zin_arg_target = {
		add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_leren_strait_closed days = 180 }
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = LER modifier = zin_leren_strait_closed_on_us }
		country_event = { id = zin_leren.90 }
	}
}

# Scope: Lerendor. Claims on every state R'en owns and a cause of war to make it a vassal, when the peace gate is open.
zin_leren_claim_r_en = {
	if = {
		limit = { zin_leren_gate_ren = yes }
		every_state = {
			limit = { owner = { original_tag = REN } }
			add_claim_by = LER
		}
		create_wargoal = {
			type = puppet_wargoal_focus
			target = REN
		}
	}
}

# Scope: Lerendor. Claims on the far shore and a cause of war against each owner, when the peace gate is open.
zin_leren_claim_far_shore = {
	if = {
		limit = { zin_leren_gate_far_shore = yes }
		every_state = {
			limit = {
				zin_is_site_strait_south = yes
				NOT = { owner = { original_tag = LER } }
			}
			add_claim_by = LER
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { original_tag = LER }
				any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_strait_south = yes }
			}
			LER = { create_wargoal = { type = take_claimed_state target = PREV } }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Lerendor proclaims itself Sovereign of the Narrow Sea; toll level 4 is allowed by its own tree flag.
zin_leren_declare_supremacy = {
	set_global_flag = zin_leren_strait_supremacy
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		news_event = { id = zin_leren.60 }
	}
}

# Scope: Lerendor. Meter fills of the Narrow Strait panel and the count of Compact crowns.
zin_leren_ui_refresh = {
	set_variable = { zin_ui_standing_fill = zin_strait_standing }
	add_to_variable = { zin_ui_standing_fill = 100 }
	multiply_variable = { zin_ui_standing_fill = 1.16 }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_ui_standing_fill min = 0 max = 232 }
	set_variable = { zin_ui_cohesion_fill = zin_leren_union_cohesion }
	multiply_variable = { zin_ui_cohesion_fill = 2.32 }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_ui_cohesion_fill min = 0 max = 232 }
	set_variable = { zin_ui_hegemony_fill = zin_leren_hegemony }
	multiply_variable = { zin_ui_hegemony_fill = 2.32 }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_ui_hegemony_fill min = 0 max = 232 }
	set_variable = { zin_ui_compact_members = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_leren_is_north_crown = yes
			is_in_faction_with = LER
		}
		LER = { add_to_variable = { zin_ui_compact_members = 1 } }
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_ui_tick = 1 }
}

# Run by the hidden event zin_leren.1: start values, spirits, dynamic modifiers, the leans, the treaty partner opinions (section 4 and the start situation).
zin_leren_startup = {
	# Lerendor
	LER = {
		save_global_event_target_as = zin_leren_country
		set_variable = { zin_strait_standing = -15 }
		set_variable = { zin_leren_toll_level = 1 }
		set_variable = { zin_leren_union_cohesion = 55 }
		set_variable = { zin_leren_hegemony = 0 }
		add_ideas = zin_leren_grievance_1716
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_leren_strait_dues }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_leren_union }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_leren_hegemony_mod }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_level = 1 }
		zin_leren_set_toll_level = yes
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0 }
		zin_leren_add_union_cohesion = yes
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { zin_is_region_north_lands = yes }
			set_state_flag = zin_leren_home_state
		}
		zin_leren_update_hegemony = yes
		zin_leren_update_treaty_band = yes
		zin_leren_ui_refresh = yes
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = AEN modifier = zin_leren_treaty_partner }
		reverse_add_opinion_modifier = { target = AEN modifier = zin_leren_treaty_partner }
	}
	# the leans of the smaller crowns
	EEK = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 60 } }
	REN = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = -25 } }
	MOO = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = -20 } }
	KER = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 10 } }
	TLV = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = -5 } }
	TOL = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 10 } }
	HEO = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 5 } }
	HRA = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 5 } }
	MIA = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 15 } }
	DOL = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 15 } }
	MUS = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 5 } }
	GOL = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = -20 } }
	DND = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 10 } }
	DRK = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 0 } }
	BUN = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 0 } }
	VES = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 0 } }
	BLK = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 10 } }
	BLN = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 0 } }
	BOR = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 0 } }
	DRE = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 0 } }
	DUL = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 0 } }
	TRO = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 0 } }
	HOO = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 0 } }
	DAK = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 0 } }
	SKR = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 0 } }
	DUN = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 0 } }
	BRT = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 0 } }
	WIL = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 0 } }
	ANE = { set_variable = { zin_leren_lean = 10 } }
}

# Scope: Lerendor. The monthly pulse of section 1 to 7: drifts, hegemony, bands, the Keepers of the Strait, the call to the treaty, the withdrawal checks, the layouts.
zin_leren_monthly = {
	# standing drifts with the dues, the Golden Court and the route (frozen after the withdrawal)
	set_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_drift = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_toll_level value = 0 compare = equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_drift = 0.3 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_toll_level value = 2 compare = equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_drift = -0.2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_toll_level value = 3 compare = equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_drift = -0.4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_toll_level value = 4 compare = equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_drift = -0.6 } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = AEN AEN = { check_variable = { var = zin_court_corruption value = 70 compare = greater_than_or_equals } } } add_to_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_drift = -0.1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_leren_route_honour } add_to_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_drift = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_leren_route_break } add_to_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_drift = -0.2 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_leren_route_supremacy } add_to_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_drift = -0.4 } }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_leren_t_drift }
	zin_leren_add_strait_standing = yes
	# cohesion
	set_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_coh = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_toll_level value = 3 compare = greater_than_or_equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_coh = -0.2 } }
	if = { limit = { zin_leren_estates_active = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { zin_leren_t_coh = 0.2 } }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_leren_t_coh }
	zin_leren_add_union_cohesion = yes
	# the dues weigh on the coastal crowns, the Iron Toll on all of them
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_toll_level value = 3 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_leren_is_north_crown = yes
				any_owned_state = { is_coastal = yes }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -0.5 }
			zin_leren_add_lean = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_leren_toll_level value = 4 compare = equals } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_leren_is_north_crown = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -0.5 }
			zin_leren_add_lean = yes
		}
	}
	zin_leren_update_hegemony = yes
	zin_leren_update_treaty_band = yes
	# the Keepers of the Strait
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_leren_guards_strait = yes
			has_war = yes
			NOT = { has_idea = zin_leren_keepers_of_the_strait }
		}
		add_ideas = zin_leren_keepers_of_the_strait
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_idea = zin_leren_keepers_of_the_strait
			OR = {
				NOT = { zin_leren_guards_strait = yes }
				NOT = { has_war = yes }
			}
		}
		remove_ideas = zin_leren_keepers_of_the_strait
	}
	# a war with no attacker left does not call the treaty again
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = zin_leren_called_against
			NOT = { has_war_with = AEN }
		}
		clr_country_flag = zin_leren_called_against
	}
	# Aenor's defensive war calls the treaty once, however many attack (O9)
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_leren_treaty_in_force = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_leren_asked_for_time }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				has_war_with = AEN
				AEN = { has_defensive_war_with = PREV }
				NOT = { is_in_faction_with = LER }
				NOT = { is_subject_of = LER }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_leren_called_against }
			}
			save_event_target_as = zin_leren_first_attacker
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = zin_leren_first_attacker }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					has_war_with = AEN
					AEN = { has_defensive_war_with = PREV }
				}
				set_country_flag = zin_leren_called_against
			}
			event_target:zin_leren_first_attacker = { LER = { country_event = { id = zin_leren.20 } } }
			clear_global_event_target = zin_leren_first_attacker
		}
	}
	# the war has come: the court decides for an AI Lerendor, a human is asked
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_leren_treaty_in_force = yes
			has_global_flag = { flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns days > 29 }
			is_ai = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_leren_route_honour }
			check_variable = { var = zin_strait_standing value = -40 compare = less_than_or_equals }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_leren_court_decided }
		}
		set_country_flag = zin_leren_court_decided
		country_event = { id = zin_leren.35 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_leren_treaty_in_force = yes
			has_global_flag = { flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns days > 13 }
			is_ai = no
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_leren_route_honour }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_leren_route_break }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_leren_route_supremacy }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_leren_prompted }
		}
		set_country_flag = zin_leren_prompted
		country_event = { id = zin_leren.36 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_leren_strait_barred = yes
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_leren_barred_news }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_leren_barred_news
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			news_event = { id = zin_leren.55 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_completed_focus = zin_lerendor_faithful_to_the_crown
			has_global_flag = zin_afrit_king_of_east
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_leren_crown_fled_asked }
		}
		set_country_flag = zin_leren_crown_fled_asked
		country_event = { id = zin_lerendor.14 }
	}
	zin_leren_ui_refresh = yes
	# last, the trees refresh their layouts (decision E4)
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				zin_is_lerendor = yes
				zin_leren_is_north_crown = yes
			}
		}
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
	}
}
